summary: Full-stack verification of Blue Collar Alpha's 6 new features (Track 1 + Track 2). Backend: 13/13 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_bca_new_features.py (metrics shape, calendar current-month + fallback, CSV import basic/flexible-columns/skip-missing/reflect-in-metrics, loss-limit set+persist+zero, emotion set+persist+bad-value-ignored, regression on /dashboard/stats + /trades). Frontend E2E (Playwright, 390x844, admin stocktradesrvl@gmail.com): (1) Dashboard action row — metrics-btn, calendar-btn, import-btn, daily-report-btn, analyze-chart-btn, pretrade-btn ALL FOUND & tappable. (2) Metrics screen renders Profit Factor 1.69 / Expectancy +$53.04 / Win Rate 54.5% / Payoff 1.41 / Avg Win +$237.60 / Avg Loss -$168.44 / Largest +$533.70/-$383.19 / streaks 3W-4L + P&L BY DAY OF WEEK bars (Mon..Fri visible with pnl + trade count + win rate). Backend also returns by_hour + playbooks arrays (verified via pytest); scrolling deeper reveals those sections. (3) Calendar screen — 'P&L Calendar' header, month title 'July 2026', Month P&L +$74.86, Green 3 / Red 3; cal-prev + cal-next both navigate; day cells color-coded (green tint for +pnl, red for -pnl) with dollar deltas. (4) Import screen — pasted 2-row CSV into import-textarea, tapped import-run, backend returned imported=2, UI showed '✅ Imported: 2' + 'View in Journal' link. (5) Profile — loss-limit-input + loss-limit-save both work, toast/badge 'Daily loss limit set to $500' shown; POST /api/user/settings persists (verified via /auth/me returning daily_loss_limit=250 in test). (6) Trade Detail — all 8 emotion chips present (emotion-Calm/Confident/Disciplined/FOMO/Anxious/Greedy/Revenge/Bored); tapping emotion-Confident highlights it in accent orange; PUT /api/trades/{id}/emotion persists (pytest verified emotion=Confident on GET). Regression: no red screen, no pageerrors, only pre-existing shadow*/pointerEvents/useNativeDriver deprecation warnings from iter5/iter6 (unrelated to new features). NOTE: Loss banner on dashboard could not be visually reproduced because today's realized P&L for the admin was POSITIVE (+$176); the JSX condition in (tabs)/index.tsx:161 is correct (daily_pnl <= -limit) — a manual test with a negative-P&L day would show it.

minor.issue: Invalid month string silently falls back to current month (200) instead of returning 400/422. Not blocking but hides client-side bugs. Consider validating YYYY-MM format.
Invalid emotion values (e.g. 'NotAnEmotion') return 200 and are silently NOT persisted (emotion stays null). Better: return 400 with the allowed enum so the mobile client can surface a real error.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (glow helper). Non-blocking, carried from iter5/iter6.
Pre-existing warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Non-blocking.
Pre-existing warning: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported ... Falling back to JS-based animation.' Non-blocking on Expo Web.

action_items: OPTIONAL (backend): Tighten input validation on /api/dashboard/calendar (reject bad month) and /api/trades/{id}/emotion (reject bad enum with 400) — currently both silently swallow bad input.

OPTIONAL (frontend): manually verify the red 'daily loss limit hit' banner on a day with a NEGATIVE realized P&L — logic in (tabs)/index.tsx:161 looks correct but was not visually exercisable today because admin's daily_pnl was +$176. Can be tested by importing a large negative TEST_ trade dated today then setting daily_loss_limit to 10.

OPTIONAL: Metrics screen 'by_hour' and 'Playbook Performance' sections are rendered below the fold — consider adding a section anchor / tabs, or a summary card at top, so users see playbook stats without scrolling.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/metrics.tsx — clean, backend-driven, handles !has_data empty state with icon+CTA; uses pnlColor helper consistently. Good.

/app/frontend/app/calendar.tsx — UTC-safe month math (Date.UTC), pads day keys correctly to YYYY-MM-DD. Cell color mixes hex+alpha via string concat ('#XX' + '2E') which works but a Platform.select({web:'rgba(...)'}) would be more robust across RN versions.
/app/frontend/app/import.tsx — CSV path handled with fetch(uri).text() for RN Web; graceful toast on unreadable file. Textarea has autoCapitalize=none + autoCorrect=false — good for CSV pasting.
/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:161 — loss banner guard is correctly `daily_pnl <= -limit` (not `< -limit`), so hitting the limit exactly triggers the coaching UI. Good.
/app/frontend/app/trade/[id].tsx:105 — emotion chips use testID pattern `emotion-<Name>`, matching the review request exactly. Selected state uses colors.brand background — clearly visible.

Backend /api/trades/import-csv correctly enforces free-plan cap (returned `capped` flag), and CSV column matching is genuinely flexible (Ticker→Symbol, Profit→PnL, Qty→Quantity all work — verified in test_import_flexible_columns).
seed_data_creation: Imported 3 throwaway trades via API (TESTAAPL, TESTMSFT, TESTNVDA) + 2 more via UI (TESTUI1, TESTUI2) to exercise CSV import and metrics/emotion flows. All are prefixed 'TEST' for cleanup. Set daily_loss_limit to 500 then reset via UI. Set one trade's emotion to 'Confident' (persists). Net effect on admin account: ~5 TEST_ trades added to journal; total balance shift negligible.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 new features SHIP-READY on both backend and frontend. CALENDAR — cal-back, cal-prev, cal-next. IMPORT — import-back, import-pick, import-textarea, import-run, import-done. PROFILE — loss-limit-input, loss-limit-save. Admin login stocktradesrvl@gmail.com / TradeAdmin123 unchanged; whats-new-dismiss + daily-quote-dismiss modals may or may not appear depending on last-seen state.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs. The two backend validation gaps (invalid month, invalid emotion) are minor UX polish items, not functional bugs; core paths are correct.
